entries.title: Leviticus 11:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These [are] the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that [are] on the earth.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:3
segments: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, [and] cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:4
segments: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: [as] the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he [is] unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:5
segments: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he [is] unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:6
segments: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he [is] unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:7
segments: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he [is] unclean to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:8
segments: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they [are] unclean to you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:9
segments: ¶These shall ye eat of all that [are] in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

words.text: of all that [are] in the waters

entries.title: Leviticus 11:10
segments: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which [is] in the waters, they [shall be] an abomination unto you:

words.text: And all that have not fins

entries.title: Leviticus 11:11
segments: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

words.text: They shall be even an abomination
unto you; ye shall not eat
, but ye shall have their carcases

entries.title: Leviticus 11:12
segments: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that [shall be] an abomination unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:13
segments: And these [are they which] ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they [are] an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

words.text: And these [are they which] ye shall have in abomination

entries.title: Leviticus 11:14
segments: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:15
segments: Every raven after his kind;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:16
segments: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:17
segments: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:18
segments: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:19
segments: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:20
segments: ¶All fowls that creep, going upon [all] four, [shall be] an abomination unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:21
segments: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon [all] four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:22
segments: [Even] these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

words.text: [Even] these of them ye may eat

entries.title: Leviticus 11:23
segments: But all [other] flying creeping things, which have four feet, [shall be] an abomination unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:24
segments: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

words.text: And for these ye shall be unclean

entries.title: Leviticus 11:25
segments: And whosoever beareth [ought] of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:26
segments: [The carcases] of every beast which divideth the hoof, and [is] not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, [are] unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

words.text: unto you: every one that toucheth

entries.title: Leviticus 11:27
segments: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on [all] four, those [are] unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:28
segments: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they [are] unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:29
segments: These also [shall be] unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

words.text: unto you among the creeping things

entries.title: Leviticus 11:30
segments: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:31
segments: These [are] unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

words.text: to you among all that creep

entries.title: Leviticus 11:32
segments: And upon whatsoever [any] of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether [it be] any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel [it be], wherein [any] work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

words.text: And upon whatsoever [any] of them, when they are dead

entries.title: Leviticus 11:33
segments: And every earthen vessel, whereinto [any] of them falleth, whatsoever [is] in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

words.text: , whatsoever [is] in it shall be unclean

entries.title: Leviticus 11:34
segments: Of all meat which may be eaten, [that] on which [such] water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every [such] vessel shall be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:35
segments: And every [thing] whereupon [any part] of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; [whether it be] oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: [for] they [are] unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

words.text: And every [thing] whereupon [any part] of their carcase
for pots, they shall be broken down

entries.title: Leviticus 11:36
segments: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, [wherein there is] plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean. {wherein...: Heb. a gathering together of waters}

words.text: . {wherein...: Heb. a gathering together of waters}

entries.title: Leviticus 11:37
segments: And if [any part] of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it [shall be] clean.

words.text: And if [any part] of their carcase

entries.title: Leviticus 11:38
segments: But if [any] water be put upon the seed, and [any part] of their carcase fall thereon, it [shall be] unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:39
segments: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:40
segments: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:41
segments: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth [shall be] an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:42
segments: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon [all] four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they [are] an abomination. {hath...: Heb. doth multiply feet}

entries.title: Leviticus 11:43
segments: ¶Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby. {yourselves abominable: Heb. your souls, etc}

words.text: , neither shall ye make yourselves unclean
with them, that ye should be defiled
thereby. {yourselves abominable: Heb. your souls, etc}

entries.title: Leviticus 11:44
segments: For I [am] the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I [am] holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

words.text: with any manner of creeping thing

entries.title: Leviticus 11:45
segments: For I [am] the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I [am] holy.

words.text: you up out of the land

entries.title: Leviticus 11:46
segments: This [is] the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

entries.title: Leviticus 11:47
segments: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
